## Before you apply it

- The bundle holds no Namespace object, so the namespace gpu-operator must exist on the target before these objects are applied. 1 object of a custom kind sets no namespace. This file does not decide whether those kinds are namespaced.
- Apply the 8 CustomResourceDefinitions first and wait until each is established. `routes/crd-ordering.yaml` declares that order.
- The chart's Helm hooks are not in this bundle. `routes/lifecycle-actions.yaml` names 3 actions and the phase each belongs to. Never apply a hook object with the base.
